What micro1 sells

  • Realm: Tests advanced AI models and provides reinforcement learning environments (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores).
  • Cortex: Tests AI agents in live use and helps improve their performance.
  • Robotics: Training data from experts demonstrating real-world tasks.
